page_title: UFO: A UI-Focused Agent for Windows OS Interaction

summary.name: UFO
summary.one_liner: UFO is a UI-focused agent from Microsoft that uses GPT-Vision to carry out natural-language requests across applications on Windows OS.
keywords: automate windows apps with natural language
use_cases: automating daily tasks in Windows applications
completing requests that span multiple applications
turning multi-step GUI workflows into natural language commands
summary.what_it_does: UFO is a Windows OS agent that uses GPT-Vision to observe and analyze the graphical user interface and control information of Windows applications. It uses a dual-agent framework to navigate and operate within a single application and across several applications to fulfill user requests. A control interaction module performs action grounding without human intervention, enabling fully automated execution. The authors tested UFO on 9 popular Windows applications, using quantitative metrics and real-case studies. The page describes this as a research paper (arXiv, v1 Feb 2024, v5 May 2024) and links to open-source code on GitHub.
notable: Dual-agent framework that observes GUI and control information of Windows apps
Control interaction module for automated action grounding without human intervention
Works across multiple applications within one request
caveats: Requires GPT-Vision (a paid OpenAI model) to operate, as implied by the abstract
Tested on 9 popular Windows applications only; the page makes no broader coverage claim
